intuition: For each position, multiply the product of values to its left by the product of values to its right.

brute_force.approach: For every index, multiply all elements except the one at that index.

optimal.approach: Write prefix products into the output, then scan backward while multiplying in the suffix product. The output array is excluded from extra-space accounting.

edge_cases: A single element produces [1], the empty product.
Zeros need no special branch: prefix and suffix products naturally produce zero outputs, including when exactly one input is zero.
